next_unblocked_work: Reconcile the broader expected MBS/PBS historical period and source-family denominators, source-era semantics, utilization evidence, and source-specific rights; receipt coverage for current-index MBS-XML links alone does not establish complete historical, PBS, or M-107 qualification.
denominator_boundary: The current Downloads index lists 55 page URLs and 531 resource links, including 82 distinct MBS-XML links across 41 pages. The initial exact-source-URL comparison at archive revision 52ad5c31cfe101c487a4c7a9c382540642e6110a matched 10 links and left 72 without a receipt at that earlier revision. The refreshed comparison at revision 51da37714b2ea3ac3b0376d28769595e8c6e9c14 matched 78 links; the remaining four URLs on Downloads-210615 were then published using collision-safe URL-derived paths. The current revision da83cad9116e2f9a5b927be7b080e9a5e5ea6998 now has exact receipts for all 82 current-index MBS-XML URLs, based on 87 B1 schedule receipt sidecars. The separate Previous Downloads page lists 105 historical PDF files spanning 1974–2010; its 106th resource link is site-wide RSS, excluded from the historical-file count. This is an index-level format-separated starting inventory, not a complete expected MBS/PBS period denominator or M-107 acceptance.

archive_receipt_refresh.basis: Exact URL match between all 82 official Downloads-index MBS-XML links and the B1 receipt metadata read from the anonymously readable immutable public archive manifest; only manifest and B1 JSON sidecars were requested, not raw XML payloads.
